evidence: Numeric excerpt of two simulator exports of the same real talking take (iPhone engine, DeviceMontageRenderE2ETests on an iOS 26.5 iPhone Air simulator, 2026-11-04). No media, transcripts or signed URLs are included.

take.kind: real human talking take, Turkish, quiet room (stand-in; not the creator's footage)
take.word_stamps: local faster-whisper small (stand-in for production whisper-1)

measure: ffmpeg highpass=f=90,silencedetect=n=-38dB:d=0.12 between first+0.2 s and last-0.2 s whisper.cpp word; pass when longest <= 0.35 s
